caption: The drawing features a geometric and floral decorative pattern, predominantly in shades of dark blue and white. It is divided into several sections. The right section displays a grid of octagonal and square shapes filled with symmetrical floral motifs and ornate borders. The left section contains two vertical bands: a broader one with white foliage and flower patterns on a dark blue background, and a narrower band with a repeated small floral motif. At the bottom, there are two horizontal bands: one with a large, stylized white flower pattern inside a rectangular frame, and another with intricate, intertwining floral vines and smaller flowers extending horizontally. The entire composition is bordered by fine lines, and the artist’s name appears in the lower right corner. The drawing uses contrast between the dark blue background and the white patterns to create detailed, high-contrast designs.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
